processes:task-sd-design-verify-7pcjse.plain_language_name: Test the Intent and Trade-offs Before Bounding the Design Space
processes:task-sd-design-verify-7pcjse.plain_language_description: Before the option design space is drawn, the arriving intent and trade-off material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-7pcjse.business_purpose: It exists because a design space bounded over an unverified intent or half-scoped trade-offs fences the options around the wrong centre.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-7pcjse.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the bounding material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged intent and trade-offs against what the activity requires, and writes up a trade-off boundary still marked provisional as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-dmkpk.plain_language_name: Draw the Design Space the Intent and Trade-offs Permit
processes:task-sd-design-transform-dmkpk.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the bounding proper begins. The processing custodian marks out what the committed intent and the scoped trade-offs permit the option designers to explore, producing the bounded design space in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-dmkpk.business_purpose: It exists because options designed without a bounded space wander past what the intent will wear and the trade-offs allow.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-dmkpk.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the bounded design space produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function marks the edges of what the option designers may explore, reading the verified intent against the scoped trade-offs, and keeps the bounding workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-intake-8zsun4.practical_context: It opens when the drafted options and the criteria are presented for commitment, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the drafted options and their evaluation criteria into the commitment file, so the commitment work starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-2v52ye.plain_language_name: Test the Option Designs and Criteria Before Committing Them

processes:task-sd-design-verify-2v52ye.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the design material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged designs and criteria against what the activity requires, and writes up an option with no stated trade-offs as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-s5dk4t.plain_language_name: Test the Assumption Set Before Drafting the Scenarios
processes:task-sd-design-verify-s5dk4t.plain_language_description: Before any scenario is drafted, the arriving assumption material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-s5dk4t.business_purpose: It exists because scenarios drafted over a thin assumption set rehearse only the futures nobody fears.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-s5dk4t.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the assumption material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged assumptions against what the activity requires, and writes up an assumption missing its stress extreme as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-3a9v5.plain_language_name: Draft the Scenarios Within the Bounded Assumptions
processes:task-sd-design-transform-3a9v5.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the drafting proper begins. The processing custodian works the bounded assumptions into distinct, coherent worlds the options must survive, producing the drafted scenarios in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-3a9v5.business_purpose: It exists because a strategy proved in only one future is a bet; scenarios are how the other futures get their say.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-3a9v5.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the drafted scenarios produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function works the verified assumptions into distinct and coherent scenario worlds, and keeps the drafting workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-confirm-r44cn5.plain_language_name: Hand the Drafted Scenarios to the Signpost Designing
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-r44cn5.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the scenarios are drafted. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the drafted scenarios are available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the drafting.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-r44cn5.business_purpose: It exists so the signposts are designed for confirmed scenarios rather than for worlds still being imagined.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-r44cn5.practical_context: It opens when the drafted scenarios are ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the drafting's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function hands the drafted scenarios to the signpost team, reconciles them against what the drafting promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-sd-design-record-yvvmu5.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so which futures were written down, and which were left out, stays answerable when events make the choice look wise or blind.
processes:task-sd-design-record-yvvmu5.business_purpose: It exists because the futures a strategy ignored are as telling as the ones it rehearsed, and both deserve evidence.
processes:task-sd-design-record-yvvmu5.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the drafting evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the drafting evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the imagined futures and the omitted ones are traceable from the record.

processes:task-sd-design-intake-hpm5ku.plain_language_name: Take In the Comparison Results for the Preference Work
processes:task-sd-design-intake-hpm5ku.plain_language_description: The articulation opens as its material arrives: the comparison results that say how each option fared against the criteria. The intake custodian logs them against the articulation file so the articulating starts accounted for.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-hpm5ku.business_purpose: It exists so the preference is articulated over logged results rather than over the loudest advocate's summary.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-hpm5ku.practical_context: It opens when the comparison results are presented for articulation, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the comparison results into the articulation file, so the preference work starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-bwq35j.plain_language_name: Test the Comparison Results Before Articulating the Preference
processes:task-sd-design-verify-bwq35j.plain_language_description: Before any preference is stated, the arriving results material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-bwq35j.business_purpose: It exists because a preference built on partial results crowns an option before the evidence is all in.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-bwq35j.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the results material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged results against what the activity requires, and writes up a comparison missing one option's scores as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-c5jvg.plain_language_name: State the Preferred Option and the Trade-Offs It Accepts
processes:task-sd-design-transform-c5jvg.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the articulating proper begins. The processing custodian reads the comparison results into one preferred option and names plainly what that choice gives up, producing the articulated preference in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-c5jvg.business_purpose: It exists because a choice whose costs go unstated is a choice nobody has really made.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-c5jvg.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the articulated preference produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function reads the verified results into a preferred option, writing down the trade-offs it accepts in plain terms, and keeps the articulation workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-confirm-cykc3n.plain_language_name: Hand the Articulated Preference to the Choice Commitment
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-cykc3n.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the preference is articulated. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the articulated preference is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the articulation.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-cykc3n.business_purpose: It exists so the strategic choice is committed over a stated preference rather than over a hunch between meetings.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-cykc3n.practical_context: It opens when the articulated preference is ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the articulation's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function hands the articulated preference to the commitment team, reconciles it against what the articulation promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-sd-design-record-e8qr6e.plain_language_name: File the Strategic Preference Articulation Evidence
processes:task-sd-design-record-e8qr6e.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so what the preference gave up, and why that was accepted, stays answerable when the trade-offs later bite.
processes:task-sd-design-record-e8qr6e.business_purpose: It exists because accepted trade-offs come due eventually, and the acceptance must be provable when they do.
processes:task-sd-design-record-e8qr6e.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the articulation evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the articulation evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the accepted trade-offs and their reasoning are traceable from the record.

processes:task-sd-design-intake-wjsqsp.plain_language_name: Take In the Committed Option Designs and the Evaluation Criteria
processes:task-sd-design-intake-wjsqsp.plain_language_description: The bounding opens as its material arrives: the committed option designs together with the criteria they must be judged by. The intake custodian logs them against the bounding file so the bounding starts accounted for.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-wjsqsp.business_purpose: It exists so the evaluation is bounded over logged designs and criteria rather than over whatever comparison is convenient.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-wjsqsp.practical_context: It opens when the committed designs and the criteria are presented for bounding, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the committed option designs and the evaluation criteria into the bounding file, so the evaluation scoping starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-8fd48z.plain_language_name: Test the Designs and Criteria Before Bounding the Evaluation
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8fd48z.plain_language_description: Before the evaluation scope is drawn, the arriving design and criteria material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8fd48z.business_purpose: It exists because an evaluation bounded over loose criteria or missing designs compares apples with apologies.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8fd48z.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the bounding material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged designs and criteria against what the activity requires, and writes up a criterion without a defined measure as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-w73kp.plain_language_name: Bound the Scope of the Strategic Alternatives Evaluation
processes:task-sd-design-transform-w73kp.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the bounding proper begins. The processing custodian fixes how far the comparison will run: which options, which criteria, at what depth, producing the bounded evaluation scope in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-w73kp.business_purpose: It exists because an unbounded comparison either drowns in detail or stops the moment one option looks good.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-w73kp.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the bounded evaluation scope produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function fixes how far the comparison will run, marking the options, criteria and depth it covers, and keeps the bounding workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-confirm-an64vw.plain_language_name: Hand the Bounded Evaluation Scope to the Comparison
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-an64vw.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the scope is bounded. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the bounded evaluation scope is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the bounding.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-an64vw.business_purpose: It exists so the comparison runs inside a confirmed scope rather than inside terms still being negotiated.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-an64vw.practical_context: It opens when the bounded evaluation scope is ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the bounding's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function hands the bounded scope to the comparison team, reconciles it against what the bounding promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-sd-design-record-tpsab2.plain_language_name: File the Evaluation Scope Bounding Evidence
processes:task-sd-design-record-tpsab2.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so what the evaluation covered, and what it left out, stays answerable when the verdict is challenged.
processes:task-sd-design-record-tpsab2.business_purpose: It exists because every challenge to a verdict begins with what was compared, and that must be provable.
processes:task-sd-design-record-tpsab2.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the bounding evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the bounding evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a contested verdict's coverage is settled from the record.

processes:task-sd-design-intake-pdyjxp.plain_language_name: Take In the Articulated Preference for the Choice Commitment
processes:task-sd-design-intake-pdyjxp.plain_language_description: The committing opens as its material arrives: the articulated preference that names the option to carry forward. The intake custodian logs it against the commitment file so the committing starts accounted for.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-pdyjxp.business_purpose: It exists so the strategic choice is committed over logged preference material rather than over momentum.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-pdyjxp.practical_context: It opens when the articulated preference is presented for commitment, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the articulated preference into the commitment file, so the choice commitment starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-8amgyt.plain_language_name: Test the Articulated Preference Before Committing the Choice
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8amgyt.plain_language_description: Before the preference is committed as the strategic choice, the arriving preference material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8amgyt.business_purpose: It exists because the committed choice steers everything downstream, and a flawed preference committed now shapes years of work wrongly.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-8amgyt.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the preference material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged preference against what the activity requires, and writes up an accepted trade-off never stated in the comparison as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-4u5nb.plain_language_name: Commit the Preferred Option as the Strategic Choice
processes:task-sd-design-transform-4u5nb.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the committing proper begins. The processing custodian fixes the preferred option as the strategic choice the downstream plan build will carry, producing the committed strategic choice in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-4u5nb.business_purpose: It exists because preference without commitment changes nothing; the enterprise only moves when the choice is fixed.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-4u5nb.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the committed strategic choice produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function commits the verified preference as the strategic choice for the plan build, keeping the committing workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-confirm-th8wjc.plain_language_name: Tell the Plan Build the Strategic Choice Is Made
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-th8wjc.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the choice is committed. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the committed strategic choice is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the commitment.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-th8wjc.business_purpose: It exists so the plan build starts from one announced choice rather than from betting on which option won.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-th8wjc.practical_context: It opens when the committed strategic choice is ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the commitment's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function tells the plan build team the strategic choice is made, reconciles the delivered choice against what the commitment promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-sd-design-record-g5pnx2.plain_language_name: File the Strategic Choice Commitment Evidence
processes:task-sd-design-record-g5pnx2.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so which option was committed, against which comparison, stays provable for as long as the choice steers the enterprise.
processes:task-sd-design-record-g5pnx2.business_purpose: It exists because the committed choice is the trunk every later plan grows from, and its evidence must be durable.
processes:task-sd-design-record-g5pnx2.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the commitment evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the commitment evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the choice that steers the enterprise is always traceable from the record.

processes:task-sd-design-intake-nnrztu.plain_language_name: Take In the Option Designs and Criteria Within the Evaluation Scope
processes:task-sd-design-intake-nnrztu.plain_language_description: The comparing opens as its material arrives: the committed option designs and the criteria within the bounded evaluation scope. The intake custodian logs them against the comparison file so the comparing starts accounted for.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-nnrztu.business_purpose: It exists so the comparison runs over logged designs and criteria rather than over summaries prepared to persuade.
processes:task-sd-design-intake-nnrztu.practical_context: It opens when the designs and criteria are presented for comparison, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the option designs and criteria within the bounded scope into the comparison file, so the comparing starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-design-verify-dq3zxj.plain_language_name: Test the Designs and Criteria Before Running the Comparison
processes:task-sd-design-verify-dq3zxj.plain_language_description: Before any option is scored, the arriving comparison material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-dq3zxj.business_purpose: It exists because scoring options against wrong or missing criteria wastes the whole comparison and misleads the preference.
processes:task-sd-design-verify-dq3zxj.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the comparison material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged designs and criteria against what the activity requires, and writes up an option that sits outside the bounded scope as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-design-transform-7c9b6.plain_language_name: Score the Options Against the Criteria Within the Scope
processes:task-sd-design-transform-7c9b6.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the comparing proper begins. The processing custodian runs each option against the criteria inside the bounded scope, producing the comparison results in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-7c9b6.business_purpose: It exists because preference needs evidence; the comparison is where the options are finally made to face the same questions.
processes:task-sd-design-transform-7c9b6.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the comparison results produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function runs each verified option against the agreed criteria within the bounded scope, scoring them on the same terms, and keeps the comparison workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-design-confirm-3rgyaj.plain_language_name: Hand the Comparison Results to the Preference Articulation
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-3rgyaj.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the comparison stands. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the comparison results are available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the comparing.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-3rgyaj.business_purpose: It exists so the preference is read from confirmed results rather than from a scorecard still being tallied.
processes:task-sd-design-confirm-3rgyaj.practical_context: It opens when the comparison results are ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the comparing's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function hands the comparison results to the articulation team, reconciles them against what the comparing promised, and issues the confirmation.

processes:task-sd-design-record-3uafkp.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so how each option scored, and on what evidence, stays answerable long after the choice is made.
processes:task-sd-design-record-3uafkp.business_purpose: It exists because the scores behind the preference must stay reconstructable for the life of the strategy.
processes:task-sd-design-record-3uafkp.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the comparison evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the comparison evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the scoring behind the preference is always reconstructable from the record.

processes:task-sd-improve-record-dc8xg4.plain_language_name: File the Adjustment Implications Assessment Evidence
processes:task-sd-improve-record-dc8xg4.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so what each candidate adjustment would cost the objectives, targets, plan and portfolio stays answerable when the direction debate resumes.
processes:task-sd-improve-record-dc8xg4.business_purpose: It exists because adjustment debates recur, and the assessed implications must be retrievable rather than re-argued from scratch.
processes:task-sd-improve-record-dc8xg4.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the assessment evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the assessment evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so each adjustment's known cost to the plan and portfolio is traceable from the record.
